caption:
Momo sleeps with her arm over her head every night, and lately her shoulder is stiff every single morning.

Keeping the arm overhead for hours holds the shoulder in one position, which may leave it stiff, or your hand tingly, by morning. You don't have to force a new sleep position; small changes to where your arm rests can help.

Hybi's tip: sleep on your side hugging a pillow, try gentle arm swings in the morning, and lift the arm slowly after a warm shower.

Trouble lifting your arm, pain that wakes you, or pins and needles that linger are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
